executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $184.38 per resident day (45.1% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.

Cost year 2025: the home recorded $3,243,738 in Connecticut Medicaid revenue (after its Medicaid contractual allowance) for 10,305 Medicaid days, $314.77 per Medicaid day. DSS's Medicaid daily rate was $302.74 for July 2024 to June 2025 and $307.72 for July 2025 to June 2026.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 5.0% (Connecticut median 2.5%).

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $697,438, $33.34 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $358,489 (51.4%), allocated fringe $48,841 (7.0%), non-wage costs $290,108 (41.6%). Raw food was $259,283 ($12.4 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61).
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $245,471, $11.74 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $176,563 (71.9%), allocated fringe $24,055 (9.8%), non-wage costs $44,853 (18.3%).
Cost year 2025: laundry cost $141,449, $6.76 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.66). Wages $110,332 (78.0%), allocated fringe $15,032 (10.6%), non-wage costs $16,085 (11.4%).
Missing data: No related parties or management-service payees were read from the cost year 2025 report. That means none were read, not that none exist.

findings.statement: Cost year 2025: DSS's review changed 13 line(s) of the report, a net increase of $18,493 in the costs DSS counts. Largest: Dues And Membership Fees (page 16 line m8), removed $107,842; Other A&G Expenses (page 16 line m13), added $87,824; Administrators (page 10 line A2), added $84,049. Separately, the home itself removed $631,694 from the costs it claimed (for example bad debt, pharmacy or therapy that the daily rate does not cover). The data shows each change, not the reason.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
